method.bridge: Same distinct bodies; body-only whole and local screens, excluding unavailable local-body contexts from both sides. Titles are not part of the bridge.
method.quarterly: Original 1.0 explicit-HNB title plus body segments; one contribution per distinct body per quarter; earliest within-quarter title. Whole-period counts are separate sets.
method.normalization: Lowercase and ASCII whitespace as in 1.0
method.validation: Development checks only; independent human validation and unmatched-screen audit pending.
method.suppression: N<30: no rate; 0<count<30: no rate; true zero stays zero. Partial 2026 Q3 excluded from complete-quarter comparisons.
